description: This PHP class implements a custom image renderer for Markdown content in the Confluence format, handling external image URLs distinctly and delegating rendering of local images to a parent renderer.

classes.name: ImageRenderer
classes.description: A custom renderer for images in Markdown content, handling external image URLs separately and delegating local image rendering to a standard renderer.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ImageRenderer with an instance of the original ImageRenderer.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders an image node; if the URL is external (starts with 'http'), it encapsulates it in custom HTML elements, otherwise, it delegates rendering to the parent renderer.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration options by passing them to the parent renderer.
